from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Net income and total revenues from one company's filing for the quarter."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    net_income: float | None = Field(description="Consolidated net income/loss for the period; negative for losses")
    net_income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of net_income: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    total_revenues: float | None = Field(description="Total revenues/sales for the period")
    revenues_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of total_revenues: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period in YYYY-MM format")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt showing net income and revenues")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
